title: Public Exact-SKU Latest-Recorded Capacity-Source Read
purpose: Return the structurally valid highest recorded capacity-source row returned by the injected read for one exact SKU stream.

selector.capture: Strict exact own-data keys at both levels, no getters, symbols, inherited-only fields, extras, coercion or trimming. Reuse parseFoodSkuId and validateFoodVersion. Capture frozen detached selector before database work.

dependencies: FOOD-007C read-only database interface and result union
storageValidation: Require success === true and array results, zero rows -> not-found, more than one row -> storage-failure. Require exact own data columns, reconstruct canonical durable value, validate through FOOD-007B, and compare returned SKU ID/version to captured selector. Canonical positive safe revision and nonnegative safe capacity; preserve metadata exactly.
highestRow: Validate highest recorded row only. Malformed highest row -> storage-failure. No fallback to older valid rows, retry, exact selected revision lookup or backward scan.
failures: Prepare/bind/all exceptions, unsuccessful or malformed envelope, malformed highest row, unexpected row count or returned identity mismatch -> storage-failure, never not-found.
ownership: Canonical validator detaches/freezes durable value and nested SKU; freeze result. Do not freeze or mutate caller, database or storage rows.
safeClaim: A structurally valid highest-revision capacity-source assertion returned by the injected database read for the requested exact SKU stream was obtained.
sessionCaveat: Conditional on injected database/session semantics; no globally freshest-state guarantee or perpetual authority. A later revision may be appended immediately after the read.
invariants: latest stored revision != fresh physical count
privateHelper: This unit does not reuse, export or repair FOOD-007B's private append-oriented latest helper. Its LIMIT 2 / multiple-row rejection concern is separate follow-up only.
sideEffects: Read-only server-library export. No route, reservation access, slot access, writes, clocks, network, environment, randomness, acceptance or migration access.
